name: kirion_plan_custody_scan_guard()
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kirion_plan_custody_scan_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    generation record;
BEGIN
    SELECT sha256, size_bytes, custody_state INTO generation
      FROM public.plan_custody_generations
     WHERE id = NEW.plan_custody_generation_id;
    IF NOT FOUND
       OR generation.custody_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'QUARANTINED'
       OR generation.sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.scanned_sha256
       OR generation.size_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.scanned_size_bytes
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'scanner evidence must pin the quarantined generation digest and size'
            USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION legacy_custody.expected_links(op uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(linkable_type text, source_id bigint, relationship text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE r.source_kind WHEN 'transaction' THEN 'App\Models\WorkflowTransaction' WHEN 'correspondence' THEN 'App\Models\CorrespondenceRecord' ELSE 'App\Models\TravelOrder' END,
 r.source_id,'supporting_document'::text
 FROM legacy_custody.command_results r JOIN legacy_custody.operations o USING(operation_id)
 WHERE r.operation_id=op AND o.command_kind IN ('transaction_create','correspondence_register','travel_record')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT CASE r.source_kind WHEN 'transaction' THEN 'App\Models\TransactionEvent' WHEN 'correspondence' THEN 'App\Models\CorrespondenceEvent' ELSE 'App\Models\TravelOrderEvent' END,
 r.event_id,CASE WHEN o.command_kind IN ('transaction_create','correspondence_route') OR
 (o.command_kind='transaction_transition' AND o.command_action IN ('forward','send_to_mayor','return_origin','request_information'))
 THEN 'route_evidence' ELSE 'action_evidence' END
 FROM legacy_custody.command_results r JOIN legacy_custody.operations o USING(operation_id) WHERE r.operation_id=op
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION legacy_custody.reservation_complete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE n integer;
BEGIN
 SELECT item_count INTO n FROM legacy_custody.operations WHERE operation_id=NEW.operation_id;
 IF n IS NULL OR (SELECT count(*) FROM legacy_custody.operation_items WHERE operation_id=NEW.operation_id AND ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND n)<>n
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM legacy_custody.operation_items WHERE operation_id=NEW.operation_id)<>n
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legacy_custody.operation_gates WHERE operation_id=NEW.operation_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'incomplete reservation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

name: legacy_custody.zero_artifacts(uuid)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION legacy_custody.zero_artifacts(op uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT NOT row_security_active('public.documents'::regclass)
 AND NOT row_security_active('public.document_links'::regclass)
 AND NOT row_security_active('public.audit_logs'::regclass)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legacy_custody.command_results WHERE operation_id=op)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legacy_custody.bindings WHERE operation_id=op)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.documents WHERE custody_operation_id=op)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.audit_logs WHERE custody_operation_id=op)
$function$

name: ops009_guard_close_notice()
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ops009_guard_close_notice()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE matched integer;
BEGIN
    IF current_user<>'n03_command' OR session_user<>'n03_command' THEN
        RETURN NEW; -- Ordinary existing notifier unchanged.
    END IF;

    SELECT count(*) INTO matched
    FROM public.ops009_close_audit_bindings b
    JOIN legacy_custody.command_results cr ON cr.operation_id=b.operation_id
    JOIN legacy_custody.terminal_receipts tr ON tr.operation_id=b.operation_id
    JOIN legacy_custody.operations o ON o.operation_id=b.operation_id
    JOIN public.transaction_events ev ON ev.id=b.transaction_event_id
    JOIN public.transactions tx ON tx.id=b.transaction_id
    JOIN public.audit_logs audit ON audit.id=b.audit_id
    JOIN public.departments dep ON dep.id=tx.origin_department_id
    JOIN public.employees emp
      ON emp.department_id=dep.id
     AND emp.user_id=NEW.user_id
     AND emp.user_id=tx.created_by_user_id
    JOIN public.users usr ON usr.id=NEW.user_id
    WHERE cr.source_kind='transaction' AND cr.event_action='close'
      AND cr.source_id=tx.id AND cr.transaction_event_id=ev.id
      AND cr.actor_user_id=o.actor_user_id
      AND cr.office_id=o.office_id
      AND cr.correlation_id=o.correlation_id
      AND o.command_kind='transaction_transition' AND o.command_action='close'
      AND tr.outcome='COMMITTED' AND tr.fence_no=1
      AND ev.transaction_id=tx.id AND ev.action='close'
      AND audit.entity_type='App\Models\WorkflowTransaction'
      AND audit.entity_id=tx.id AND audit.action='transaction.close'
      AND audit.actor_user_id=o.actor_user_id
      AND audit.actor_department_id=o.office_id
      AND audit.correlation_id=o.correlation_id
      AND usr.is_active AND usr.account_status='active'
      AND usr.suspended_at IS NULL
      AND emp.employment_status='active'
      AND emp.separation_date IS NULL
      AND dep.is_active AND dep.is_routable
      AND NEW.department_id=dep.id
      AND NEW.event_key='transaction-event-'||ev.id::text
      AND NEW.source_domain='transaction'
      AND NEW.source_type='App\Models\WorkflowTransaction'
      AND NEW.source_id=tx.id
      AND NEW.priority='action_required'
      AND NEW.title='Transaction completed'
      AND NEW.message=tx.reference_no||' · '||tx.title
      AND NEW.action_url='/transactions/'||tx.id::text
      AND NEW.requires_acknowledgement IS FALSE
      AND NEW.read_at IS NULL AND NEW.acknowledged_at IS NULL
      AND NEW.expires_at IS NULL;
    IF matched<>1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS009 origin notice lacks verified close receipt or eligible recipient' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

name: ops009_guard_delivery_action()
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ops009_guard_delivery_action()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE n integer;
BEGIN
    SELECT count(*) INTO n
      FROM public.ops009_origin_delivery_exceptions gap
      JOIN public.users head ON head.id=NEW.actor_user_id
      JOIN public.employees emp ON emp.user_id=head.id
      JOIN public.departments dep ON dep.id=emp.department_id
     WHERE gap.id=NEW.exception_id
       AND gap.origin_department_id=NEW.actor_department_id
       AND emp.department_id=gap.origin_department_id
       AND head.role='department_head' AND head.is_active
       AND head.account_status='active' AND head.suspended_at IS NULL
       AND emp.employment_status='active' AND emp.separation_date IS NULL
       AND dep.is_active AND dep.is_routable
       AND (
           NEW.action='acknowledge'
           OR EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM public.ops009_origin_delivery_exception_actions a
                WHERE a.exception_id=gap.id AND a.action='acknowledge'
           )
       );
    IF n<>1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS009 exception action requires eligible origin Head and prior acknowledgment'
            USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

name: ops009_guard_delivery_exception()
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ops009_guard_delivery_exception()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE n integer;
BEGIN
    IF current_user <> 'n03_command'
       OR session_user <> 'n03_command' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS009 delivery gap requires N03 command identity'
            USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;

    SELECT count(*) INTO n
    FROM public.ops009_close_audit_bindings b
    JOIN legacy_custody.operations o ON o.operation_id=b.operation_id
    JOIN legacy_custody.command_results cr ON cr.operation_id=o.operation_id
    JOIN legacy_custody.terminal_receipts tr ON tr.operation_id=o.operation_id
    JOIN public.transactions tx ON tx.id=b.transaction_id
    JOIN public.transaction_events ev ON ev.id=b.transaction_event_id
    WHERE NEW.operation_id=o.operation_id
      AND NEW.transaction_id=b.transaction_id
      AND NEW.transaction_event_id=ev.id
      AND NEW.origin_department_id=tx.origin_department_id
      AND o.command_kind='transaction_transition'
      AND o.command_action='close'
      AND cr.source_kind='transaction'
      AND cr.event_action='close'
      AND cr.transaction_event_id=ev.id
      AND tr.outcome='COMMITTED' AND tr.fence_no=1
      AND ev.action='close' AND ev.transaction_id=tx.id
      AND tx.status='closed'
      AND NEW.reason='NO_ELIGIBLE_ORIGIN_RECIPIENT'
      AND NEW.custodian_role='department_head'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.platform_notifications pn
           WHERE pn.event_key='transaction-event-'||ev.id::text
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
            FROM public.users head
            JOIN public.employees emp ON emp.user_id=head.id
            JOIN public.departments dep ON dep.id=emp.department_id
           WHERE emp.department_id=tx.origin_department_id
             AND head.role='department_head'
             AND head.is_active
             AND head.account_status='active'
             AND head.suspended_at IS NULL
             AND emp.employment_status='active'
             AND emp.separation_date IS NULL
             AND dep.is_active AND dep.is_routable
      );
    IF n<>1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS009 delivery gap has no verified event or eligible custodian'
            USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

name: ops009_verify_close_audit()
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ops009_verify_close_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE matches integer;
BEGIN
    IF current_user <> 'n03_command' OR session_user <> 'n03_command' THEN
        RETURN NULL; -- Ordinary Eloquent audit remains unaffected.
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP <> 'INSERT'
       OR NEW.custody_operation_id IS NOT NULL
       OR NEW.outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'allowed'
       OR NEW.integration_client_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS009 close audit provenance rejected noncanonical row' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;

    SELECT count(*) INTO matches
    FROM public.ops009_close_audit_bindings b
    JOIN legacy_custody.operations o ON o.operation_id=b.operation_id
    JOIN legacy_custody.operation_gates g ON g.operation_id=o.operation_id
    JOIN legacy_custody.command_results cr ON cr.operation_id=o.operation_id
    JOIN legacy_custody.terminal_receipts tr ON tr.operation_id=o.operation_id
    JOIN public.transaction_events ev ON ev.id=b.transaction_event_id
    JOIN public.transactions tx ON tx.id=b.transaction_id
    JOIN public.users u ON u.id=o.actor_user_id
    JOIN public.employees emp ON emp.user_id=o.actor_user_id
    JOIN public.departments dep ON dep.id=o.office_id
    WHERE b.audit_id=NEW.id
      AND b.transaction_id=NEW.entity_id
      AND NEW.entity_type='App\Models\WorkflowTransaction'
      AND NEW.action='transaction.close'
      AND NEW.actor_user_id=o.actor_user_id
      AND NEW.actor_department_id=o.office_id
      AND NEW.correlation_id=o.correlation_id
      AND o.command_kind='transaction_transition'
      AND o.command_action='close'
      AND g.state='OPEN' AND g.fence_no=1
      AND cr.fence_no=1
      AND cr.source_kind='transaction'
      AND cr.source_id=b.transaction_id
      AND cr.transaction_event_id=b.transaction_event_id
      AND cr.event_action='close'
      AND cr.actor_user_id=o.actor_user_id
      AND cr.office_id=o.office_id
      AND cr.correlation_id=o.correlation_id
      AND tr.outcome='COMMITTED'
      AND tr.fence_no=1
      AND tr.actor_user_id=o.actor_user_id
      AND tr.manifest_digest=o.manifest_digest
      AND tr.service_identity=o.service_identity
      AND tr.evidence_ref='n03-g2b:transaction:'||b.transaction_id::text||':'||b.transaction_event_id::text
      AND ev.transaction_id=b.transaction_id
      AND ev.actor_user_id=o.actor_user_id
      AND ev.action='close'
      AND ev.from_department_id=o.office_id
      AND ev.to_department_id=o.office_id
      AND ev.new_status=tx.status
      AND tx.status='closed'
      AND tx.completed_at IS NOT NULL
      AND tx.current_department_id=o.office_id
      AND u.role='department_head' AND u.is_active AND u.account_status='active'
      AND emp.department_id=o.office_id AND emp.employment_status='active'
      AND dep.is_active AND dep.is_routable;
    IF matches <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS009 close audit event-operation-receipt provenance invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END $function$
